applicant.organisation: Indie Games Society, University of Innsbruck

purpose: We're building a mobile app with slot-machine style loot boxes, tuned to keep people who are stuck at home with chronic illness playing as long as possible. We want to know where those players are.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
